## Attack description


An resister utilisation a combination of techniques to determine the state of the larboard on a remote butt. Any service or application usable for TCP or UDP networking will have a port open for communications over the network.

## Prerequisites

**Technique:** Vulnerability scan Adversaries may scan victims for vulnerabilities that can be used during targeting. Vulnerability scan typically check if the configuration of a target host/application (ex: software and version) potentially aligns with the target of a specific exploit the adversary may seek to use. These scan may also include more broad attempts to [Gather Victim Host Information](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1592) that can be used to identify more commonly known,
